summary: Frontend-only smoke + Compare UI test of the developer Test Harness at ?tests. All 6 items of the review checklist passed: harness page renders with 32 case checkboxes; segmented Run/Compare toggle works; compare view exposes both dropdowns and Compare button with correct data-testids; Run Selected/Run All are disabled while in Compare mode; selecting two different past runs and clicking Compare renders the summary strip (Prev/New pass rate, Cases moved) and a full 32-row per-case table with verdict badges and highlighting on moved rows; toggling back to Run mode restores the normal run view; no React runtime or console errors observed throughout.
critical_code_review_comments: CompareView.runCompare has no catch branch — a failed getTestRun would leave the button in a loading state with no user feedback. Non-blocking, but a small toast/error banner would help.

diffRuns matches criteria by name only; when comparing across evaluator schema changes, criteria with renamed labels will silently be omitted from the changed list. This is expected per the task note, but a small footnote in the UI (e.g. 'criteria matched by name') would aid interpretation.

TestHarness.jsx is 508 lines and contains three components (CompareView, CaseResultCard, TestHarness). Consider splitting CompareView into its own file for readability — not urgent but approaches the 700-line guideline.
seed_data_creation: None — used the 6 existing past runs already present in the DB (dropdown populated with 6 real options).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compare UI test flow: navigate to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/?tests, click [data-testid=mode-compare-button], select two DIFFERENT non-empty options in [data-testid=compare-select-prev] and [data-testid=compare-select-new], click [data-testid=compare-run-button], wait for [data-testid=compare-summary], then verify 32 rows [data-testid^=compare-row-].
